test_suite_policy: all supplied cases; preserve expected values and original repeat/check behavior
pass: candidate compiles and every specified output assertion passes during actual execution
fail: candidate is rejected by the compiler or at least one executed output assertion mismatches
unknown: infrastructure failure, timeout, unsupported execution or missing observations; never count as pass
aggregation: report the actual denominator; missing/incomplete evaluations are not successful tasks
execution_status: Dataset packaging performs no PLC executions; experiment status is recorded separately.
